items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Like Toscanini used to get on NBC. When he'd bring that baton down, that whole orchestra hit one note.

ctx.x: The Goodman band when Toots was in there on lead alto. And Artie Shaw's band, at the ______, did the same technical perfection of symphony orchestras. A thing, real musicianship, which was part of the music. That attack -- when the whole band attacks the one man, the impact is much greater than it was sloppy. Tremendous impact without being loud, when everyone attacks precisely together. Like Toscanini used to get on NBC. When he'd bring that baton down, that whole orchestra hit one note. It would blow the hall…
